dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing observed from the mid-body region toward the visible posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: None clearly visible; lateral margins present as smooth, continuous convex curves without significant asymmetrical bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface with diffuse blue-grey shading on the lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low density; localized clusters of darker grey pixels are distributed along the central dorsal axis in the mid-to-posterior region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; the gradient between the white primary skin tone and the darker dorsal clusters exhibits a soft, gradual transition.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of dark, linear and irregular high-contrast marks along the mid-dorsal ridge, appearing as a series of distinct epidermal disruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of dark, linear scarring or marking patterns are visible on the dorsal surface, concentrated posterior to the widest point of the body.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is clearly visible and open at the anterior end of the visible dorsal plane.
